name: MPAC — Ontario Property Assessment
description: Municipal Property Assessment Corporation: look up assessed values for any Ontario property, compare assessments by municipality, and understand how assessment rolls drive property taxes.

name: EQAO — Standardized Assessment Results
description: Education Quality and Accountability Office: provincial test results for Grades 3, 6, 9, and OSSLT literacy, with school- and board-level reports downloadable as datasets.

name: Skilled Trades Ontario — Apprenticeship Registry
description: Official body for Ontario apprenticeship and trade certification: apprentice registration, trade exam schedules, certified rosters, and apprenticeship completion data.

name: Manitoba Student Aid
description: Manitoba's provincial student financial assistance program: apply for loans and grants, estimate awards, and manage repayment.

name: New Brunswick Student Financial Services
description: NB student loans and grants portal: eligibility, application, and repayment for provincial and Canada-New Brunswick integrated loans.

name: MASC — Management Plus Municipal Yield Data
description: Manitoba Agricultural Services Corporation's Management Plus: actual insured crop yields by municipality, crop type, and year — granular farm production data unavailable anywhere else.

name: Saskatchewan Ministry of Agriculture — Crop Report
description: Weekly growing-season crop reports: moisture, crop development, disease, and harvest progress by region, plus year-end statistics archives.

name: La Financière agricole du Québec (FADQ)
description: Quebec's agricultural finance agency: crop insurance program data, farm financing programs, and statistical publications on Quebec farm production and compensation.

name: OMAFA — Field Crops Statistics
description: Ontario Ministry of Agriculture field crop area, yield, and production estimates by county and crop, with multi-year statistical archives.
